text:
nina.prodeng: Heads-up team — were ready to announce the new Commitment Plans and an optional monthly overage cap. Posting draft here for ops/security/biz review before the public post.

billing-bot: [Draft saved] https://redwood.internal/drafts/commitments-2026 (preview)

omar.billing: Short summary: 1) Commitment Plans let customers pre-commit to monthly token/stream-minute volume in exchange for tiered discounts (5/12/20% at Silver/Gold/Platinum). 2) Optional Overcap Protection: customers can pay a small premium to cap monthly overage charges to a fixed percentage of their committed spend (e.g., cap at +30% of committed monthly invoice).

nina.prodeng: Key expectations: commitments offer predictable pricing and priority routing. Overcap protects customers from large unexpected bills but is only available for hosted accounts on monthly contracts; dedicated/reserved customers use existing SLA terms.

cfo.sara: Finance note: commitments should be invoiced as two line items: recurring commitment fee (prepaid for the month) and usage true-up at month end. Overcap is billed as a separate insurance-like fee up front and refunded proportionally if unused. We need GL mapping for: commitment_fee, usage_trueup, overcap_premium, overcap_credit.

engops.ryan: Ops notes: committed customers get higher soft-limits and a dedicated routing priority during congestion windows. We'll add fields to the usage/export pipeline: commitment_id, committed_units, cap_percentage, overcap_applied (true/false). Exports will include `schema_version=6`.

sales.lead: Sales playbook: offer Gold for teams with predictable monthly workloads. Playbook includes sample math and migration checklist. We'll also provide a 14-day trial of Overcap Protection for new commitments so customers can evaluate it.

billing-bot: Example invoice fragment (preview):
```
schema_version=6
invoice_id,line_type,usage_units,unit_price,amount,region_code,commitment_id,committed_units,cap_percentage,overcap_applied
inv_20260901,commitment_fee,100000,0.0004,40.00,us-west,cm_7788,100000,0.30,false
inv_20260901,tokens,120000,0.0004,48.00,us-west,cm_7788,100000,0.30,true
inv_20260901,overcap_premium,1,10.00,10.00,us-west,cm_7788,100000,0.30,false
inv_20260901,overcap_credit,1,-5.00,-5.00,us-west,cm_7788,100000,0.30,false
```

nina.prodeng: Pricing/comms guidance: emphasize predictability and the optional nature of Overcap Protection. Avoid language implying guaranteed zero bills. Example external line: "Commitment Plans give volume discounts and routing priority; add Overcap Protection to limit unexpected overage exposure."

cfo.sara: Accounting questions: how do we recognize revenue for prepaid commitment fees? Finance prefers monthly recognition aligned to usage; legal concurs on treatment. Well publish a short accounting FAQ.

engops.ryan: Implementation timeline: feature toggle on 2026-08-10, public docs + pricing calculator 2026-08-12, billing export migration (schema_version=6) 2026-08-15 02:00-03:00 UTC. Exports during migration may be schema_version=5 or 6. We'll provide migration notes and SDK parsing snippets.

omar.billing: Customer-facing examples for support: 
- Q: "I committed 100k tokens but used 150k. What happens?"
- A: "You pay the prepaid commitment fee for 100k + a true-up for the extra 50k at your committed unit rate. If you purchased Overcap Protection capped at +30%, your extra bill beyond 130k would be limited per the cap and eligible for partial credit."

sales.lead: One more: we need a simple ROI calculator for SDRs to show net savings vs on-demand. I'll coordinate with devex for a widget.

nina.prodeng: Action items:
- Product: finalize pricing tiers + FAQ copy.
- Eng: add exports & usage flags, ensure routing priority for commitment_id.
- Finance: confirm GL mappings and revenue recognition doc.
- Sales: prepare playbook and calculator.
- Support: canned responses and dispute flow for overcap credits.

billing-bot: Owners set: @omar.billing (billing), @nina.prodeng (product), @engops.ryan (ops)

cfo.sara: Approve on principle. Please include a clear UI flow for customers to opt into Overcap and see cap percentages. Also add a note about currency rounding for multi-currency invoices (billing in USD/EUR/GBP) to legal/finance review.

engops.ryan: Technical note: routing priority will be a soft preference; in extreme congestion we still fall back to fair-share. Well document this to avoid SLA expectations.

nina.prodeng: Last check  any blockers? If none, well publish the announcement and pricing calculator on 2026-08-12 16:00 UTC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
